Question: There is a unique sequence of integers \(a_1,\) \(a_2,\) \(\cdots a_{2023}\) such that \[ \begin{gathered} \tan 2023x\\ {}=\tiny\dfrac{a_1\tan x+a_3\tan^3 x+a_5\tan^5 x+\cdots+a_{2023}\tan^{2023}x}{1+a_2\tan^2 x+a_4\tan^4 x\cdots+a_{2022}\tan^{2022}x} \end{gathered} \] whenever \(\tan 2023x\) is defined. What is \(a_{2023}?\)
